summary: Implemented Phase 1 `UniformCurrentSource` end to end with a typed public model, simulation normalization, typed IR lowering, resolved-grid placement compilation, staged injection kernels/runtime helpers, an example snapshot, and representative tests.
key_findings: `UniformCurrentSource` now has explicit Phase 1 placement semantics: `field_kind`, `component_axis`, `zero_size_axes`, `placement_kind`, and `support_bounds` are derived directly from the public model.

Source compilation is discrete and grid-aware in `src/autofdtd/compiler/sources.py`: zero-size axes interpolate between neighboring cell centers when enabled, finite extents use center-in-bounds cells or overlap-fraction weights when `confine_to_bounds=True`, and `current_amplitude_definition="total"` normalizes by transverse extent.
Execution IR now includes a typed `UniformCurrentSourceIR` with nested typed `source_time` payloads instead of relying only on generic source envelopes.

Runtime injection is staged and explicit: `src/autofdtd/kernels/sources.py` and `src/autofdtd/runtime/sources.py` can build current-density terms and apply compiled electric or magnetic current sources to `(nx, ny, nz, 3)` field buffers.
Validation, examples, and tests cover normalization, IR lowering, compilation, kernel behavior, runtime batching, and example stability; the full suite passes with `143 passed`.

artifacts.description: Public `UniformCurrentSource` model and current-source normalization entrypoint.
Resolved-grid placement compiler and compiled source metadata for uniform current sources.
NumPy source-density and staged field-injection helpers with backend metadata.
Runtime helpers for building and applying compiled uniform current sources.
Typed `UniformCurrentSourceIR` lowering integrated into simulation IR.
Representative current-source placement and injection snapshot example.
End-to-end tests for model semantics, IR lowering, compilation, kernels, runtime batching, and example stability.
Updated Phase 1 working memory with source-placement and injection decisions for follow-on tasks.

follow_up_notes: Next source tasks should reuse `CompiledAxisPlacement` and the staged runtime seam for `PointDipole` and `CustomCurrentSource`, extending it for Yee-staggered placement and dataset-backed amplitudes rather than creating a separate source runtime contract.
